title: Java Developer
description: Master enterprise software engineering, resilient microservices, distributed transaction processing, and scalable architectures using Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.

goal.objective: Design and deploy robust, high-throughput enterprise systems, distributed microservices, and banking-grade backends using Java and the Spring ecosystem.

learn.summary: Master modern Java 21 (Virtual Threads, Records, Pattern Matching), Spring Boot 3, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Kafka message streaming, and Docker orchestration.
key_competencies: Spring Boot 3 REST APIs & Dependency Injection
Spring Data JPA & Hibernate ORM Tuning

capstone_projects.title: Fintech Payment Gateway & Transaction Ledger
capstone_projects.description: Build an ACID-compliant double-entry ledger with distributed tracing, idempotency keys, and asynchronous transaction publishing.

capstone_projects.title: High-Concurrency Banking Transaction Engine with Spring Boot 3
capstone_projects.description: Architect an ACID-compliant double-entry ledger handling concurrent financial transfers using optimistic locking, Kafka event sourcing, and Redis idempotency keys.

certifications: Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 17/21 Developer
interview_focus: JVM Memory Model, Garbage Collection & Virtual Threads

tree.name: Core Java Foundations
tree.description: Master the fundamental concepts of Java programming, including syntax, object-oriented principles, data structures, and advanced language features crucial for building robust applications.

children.name: Java Syntax & OOP Principles
children.description: Learn Java syntax, data types, control flow, and fundamental Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts like classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction, and encapsulation. Understand interfaces, abstract classes, records, and enums. Master `equals()`, `hashCode()`, `toString()`, and principles of immutability.

children.name: Java Collections Framework & Generics
children.description: Deep dive into the Java Collections Framework. Understand and utilize `List`, `Set`, `Map` interfaces, common implementations (ArrayList, HashMap, HashSet). Master `Iterators`, `Generics` for type safety, and how to use `Comparable` and `Comparator` for custom sorting.

children.name: Exception Handling, File I/O & Networking
children.description: Learn to manage errors effectively with Java's exception handling mechanism (checked vs unchecked, try-catch-finally, try-with-resources). Understand file operations using `java.io` (streams, readers, writers) and `java.nio` (Paths, Files, Channels). Get a basic understanding of network programming with Sockets.

children.name: Advanced Java: Lambdas & Stream API
children.description: Explore functional programming concepts in Java. Master lambda expressions, method references, and the Stream API for efficient data processing. Understand `Optional` for handling null values gracefully and the modern `java.time` API for date and time manipulations.

children.name: Java Concurrency & Multithreading
children.description: Understand the fundamentals of concurrent programming in Java. Learn about `Threads`, `Runnables`, and `Thread` lifecycles. Master synchronization mechanisms like `synchronized` blocks/methods, `volatile` keyword, and `Lock` interface. Explore the `ExecutorService`, `Callable`, `Future`, and basic concurrent collections for building high-performance applications.

children.name: JVM Internals & Memory Management
children.description: Gain insight into the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) architecture, including classloaders and runtime data areas. Understand garbage collection mechanisms (generations, common algorithms like G1, Parallel, CMS basics) and how to identify and prevent common memory leaks. Learn basic Java profiling techniques.

tree.name: Database Fundamentals & ORM
tree.description: Learn to interact with databases, from fundamental SQL concepts to advanced Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) using JPA and Hibernate, essential for persistent data storage in Java applications.

children.name: Relational Database Concepts & SQL
children.description: Understand core relational database concepts, including tables, keys, relationships. Master SQL for data definition (DDL), data manipulation (DML), and data control (DCL). Learn about database normalization and work with popular databases like PostgreSQL or MySQL.

children.name: JDBC & Basic Data Access
children.description: Learn how Java applications connect to databases using JDBC. Understand how to execute queries, use Prepared Statements to prevent SQL injection, process Result Sets, and implement connection pooling with libraries like HikariCP for efficient database interactions.

children.name: JPA & Hibernate ORM
children.description: Dive into Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) with the Java Persistence API (JPA) and its most popular implementation, Hibernate. Learn to define entities, map relationships (One-to-One, One-to-Many, Many-to-Many), write JPQL (Java Persistence Query Language) queries, and understand native SQL queries within JPA.

tree.name: Spring Boot Core & Web Development
tree.description: Master Spring Boot for building modern, production-ready backend applications and RESTful APIs with ease, focusing on core concepts, web development, and data persistence.

children.name: Spring Framework Core Concepts
children.description: Understand the foundational concepts of the Spring Framework: Dependency Injection (DI), Inversion of Control (IoC) container, Spring Beans, and core annotations like `@Component`, `@Service`, `@Repository`, `@Autowired`, `@Qualifier`, and `@Value`. Learn about Spring Profiles and Configuration using `@Configuration` and `@PropertySource`.

children.name: Introduction to Spring Boot
children.description: Learn what Spring Boot is and how it simplifies Spring application development. Understand auto-configuration, `spring-boot-starter` dependencies, embedded servers (Tomcat, Jetty), and how to build executable JARs. Explore Command Line Runner for application startup logic.

children.name: Building RESTful APIs with Spring Boot
children.description: Develop RESTful web services using Spring Boot. Master `@RestController` and `@RequestMapping`. Understand HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH), request/response handling using `@RequestBody`, `@ResponseBody`, `ResponseEntity`, path variables, and request parameters. Learn to structure APIs with Data Transfer Objects (DTOs).

children.name: Data Validation & Global Exception Handling
children.description: Implement robust data validation using the Bean Validation API (`@Valid`, `@Validated`) and create custom validators. Learn to handle exceptions globally across your REST APIs using `@ControllerAdvice` and `@ExceptionHandler`, providing consistent and informative error responses.

resources.title: Global Exception Handling in Spring Boot

children.name: Spring Data JPA & Transactions
children.description: Simplify data access with Spring Data JPA. Implement the Repository Pattern using `CrudRepository` and `JpaRepository`. Write custom queries with `@Query`, handle pagination and sorting, and ensure data integrity with declarative transaction management using `@Transactional`.

tree.name: Enterprise-Grade Spring Development
tree.description: Advance your Spring skills to build secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise applications by integrating security, messaging, caching, and exploring advanced Spring features.

children.name: Spring Security & Authorization
children.description: Implement robust security in your Spring Boot applications. Differentiate between authentication and authorization. Learn to secure endpoints with Basic Auth, Form Login, JWT (JSON Web Tokens), and explore basics of OAuth2 (Resource Server, Client). Apply method-level security using `@PreAuthorize` and `@PostAuthorize`.

children.name: Messaging & Event-Driven Architectures
children.description: Integrate messaging queues into your Spring applications. Understand message queue concepts (Producer, Consumer). Implement Spring AMQP for RabbitMQ or Spring Kafka for high-throughput messaging. Explore the basics of Event-Driven Architecture, design for idempotency, and implement retry mechanisms for message processing.

children.name: Caching Strategies with Spring
children.description: Improve application performance using caching. Understand different caching strategies (in-memory, distributed). Utilize Spring's Cache Abstraction with annotations like `@Cacheable`, `@CachePut`, and `@CacheEvict`. Explore integration with caching providers like Ehcache or Redis.

children.name: Resilience Patterns & Microservices Communication
children.description: Design resilient microservices using patterns like Circuit Breaker (e.g., Resilience4j), Bulkhead, and Retry. Explore inter-service communication mechanisms (REST, gRPC) and pattern implementations like API Gateways (e.g., Spring Cloud Gateway) for routing and cross-cutting concerns, and Service Discovery (e.g., Eureka, Consul) for dynamic service location.

resources.title: Building an API Gateway with Spring Cloud Gateway
Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka for Service Discovery

children.name: Advanced Spring Features
children.description: Explore specialized Spring modules. Understand Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP) for cross-cutting concerns. Get an introduction to reactive programming with Spring WebFlux and Spring Reactor. Discover Spring Batch for building robust batch processing applications.

tree.name: Testing & Quality Assurance
tree.description: Develop high-quality, reliable Java applications by mastering various testing methodologies, build tools, and dependency management strategies.

children.name: Unit Testing with JUnit & Mockito
children.description: Write effective unit tests for your Java code using JUnit 5 (annotations, assertions). Learn to mock dependencies and verify interactions using Mockito. Understand the principles of Test-Driven Development (TDD) to design better code.

children.name: Integration & Component Testing
children.description: Perform comprehensive testing using Spring Boot Test annotations like `@SpringBootTest`, `@WebMvcTest`, and `@DataJpaTest`. Leverage Testcontainers to spin up real databases and message brokers for reliable integration tests. Use REST Assured for testing RESTful APIs.

children.name: Build Tools & Dependency Management
children.description: Master essential build automation tools. Learn Maven (POM, build lifecycle, plugins) and Gradle (Groovy/Kotlin DSL, tasks, plugins) for compiling, testing, and packaging your applications. Understand dependency management, including dependency scopes and transitive dependencies.

tree.name: Deployment & Operations
tree.description: Learn to deploy, monitor, and maintain Java applications in production environments, covering version control, containerization, cloud platforms, and observability practices.

children.name: Version Control & CI/CD
children.description: Master Git for version control, including branching, merging, and rebasing strategies. Understand the principles of Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Deployment (CD). Get familiar with basic configurations for CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.

children.name: Containerization & Orchestration
children.description: Learn to containerize Java applications using Docker. Master Dockerfile creation, image building, container management, volumes, and networks. Use Docker Compose for multi-container applications. Get an introduction to container orchestration with Kubernetes (Pods, Deployments, Services).

children.name: Monitoring, Logging & Tracing
children.description: Implement observability for production applications. Utilize Spring Boot Actuator for health checks and metrics. Implement structured logging with SLF4J and Logback/Log4j2. Explore centralized logging solutions (ELK Stack basics), metrics collection (Micrometer, Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Zipkin).

resources.title: Monitoring Spring Boot with Prometheus and Grafana

children.name: Cloud Deployment Basics
children.description: Get an introduction to deploying applications on major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure). Learn to deploy Spring Boot applications to Platform as a Service (PaaS) offerings like Heroku or AWS Elastic Beanstalk, or container services. Understand Database as a Service (e.g., AWS RDS, GCP Cloud SQL).

resources.title: Deploy Spring Boot to AWS EC2

tree.name: Software Design & Best Practices
tree.description: Cultivate strong software engineering practices, focusing on robust design principles, clean code, effective refactoring, and professional API design.

children.name: Object-Oriented Design & Patterns
children.description: Deepen your understanding of Object-Oriented Design (OOD) with SOLID Principles. Explore common Gang of Four Design Patterns (Creational, Structural, Behavioral) and understand their application in real-world scenarios. Get an introduction to Domain-Driven Design (DDD) concepts.

children.name: Clean Code & Refactoring
children.description: Learn to write maintainable, readable, and efficient code. Identify and eliminate code smells. Master refactoring techniques to improve existing codebases without changing external behavior. Understand the importance and process of effective code reviews.

children.name: API Design Principles & Documentation
children.description: Design well-structured and user-friendly RESTful APIs. Understand best practices for API versioning strategies, error handling, and resource naming. Learn to document your APIs effectively using OpenAPI/Swagger for better collaboration and consumption.

tree.name: Capstone Project: Full-Stack Banking Application
tree.description: Apply all learned skills to build a comprehensive, production-ready full-stack banking application, demonstrating proficiency in modern Java development practices.

children.name: Project Planning & Architecture
children.description: Define the scope, gather requirements, and design the architecture for a banking application. This includes database schema design, API endpoint definitions, and technology stack selection.

children.name: Implementation & Testing
children.description: Develop core banking features such as user management, account creation, transaction processing (deposit, withdrawal, transfer). Integrate Spring Security for authentication and authorization (using JWT or OAuth2). Write comprehensive unit and integration tests, and manage database schema changes using Flyway or Liquibase.

children.name: Deployment & Documentation
children.description: Containerize the application using Docker, then deploy it to a chosen cloud platform (e.g., AWS, GCP). Implement robust monitoring and logging solutions. Generate detailed OpenAPI documentation for the API, ensuring it's ready for future development and consumption.
